description: This Python source file defines a BenchmarkRunner subclass for benchmarking padded matrix multiplication (pad_mm). It includes methods for creating input data, running benchmarks, and generating random tensor dimensions suitable for memory constraints, as well as choosing data types. It is used to generate training data for heuristic learning with AutoHeuristic in the PyTorch project.
